issues.description: Animal.name is specified as a String in the UML/problem statement, but the solution declares it as a StringBuilder. This contradicts the required class design (constructor/getter/setter for a String name) and can confuse students implementing the attribute type to match the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the UML/spec by changing `private StringBuilder name;` to `private String name;`, and update the constructor, getter, and setter to store/return/assign Strings directly.
